headlineOfDay: Nvidia's board weighs ousting CEO Jensen Huang over affair claims, sending the chip giant down 8% after hours and unsettling the AI trade.

markets.summary: US stocks rallied on Wednesday, with the S&P 500 up 1.3% and the Nasdaq up 1.6%, led by chip and AI names after a strong CoreWeave report. The FTSE 100 gained 0.8% and the Euro Stoxx 50 rose 1.0%, while miners and Shell lagged in London. Futures turned lower after hours as Nvidia fell sharply on reports its board may remove its chief executive.

stories.headline: Nvidia slides after hours on reports board may remove Huang
stories.summary: Nvidia shares fell around 8-9% in extended trading after reports that its board was weighing whether to oust chief executive Jensen Huang following a second alleged affair, with Nasdaq futures and Asian shares lower. The uncertainty matters because Nvidia sits at the centre of the AI trade and of a web of financing ties across the sector.
